title: Supply and Delivery of 500 Metric Tons of Cement
description: The Kenya Rural Roads Authority (KeRRA) invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for the supply and delivery of 500 metric tons of Portland cement grade 42.5N to various construction sites across the country. Delivery points include Nairobi (depot), Kisumu (regional office), and Mombasa (port storage). Bidders must demonstrate capability to supply in batches of 100 tons minimum within 14 days of purchase order. Required documentation: valid tax compliance certificate, certificate of incorporation, three recent reference letters from similar contracts above KES 5M value.

title: Provision of Road Haulage Services - Western Kenya Corridor
description: Kenya Power invites tenders for the provision of road haulage and logistics services for movement of electrical transformers, poles, and associated equipment between Nairobi warehouse and various sites in Western Kenya (Kisumu, Kakamega, Bungoma, Busia). Contract duration: 24 months, renewable subject to performance. Required: minimum fleet of 10 heavy commercial vehicles (30+ ton capacity), valid cargo insurance, certified fleet maintenance schedule.

title: Supply of Aggregates and Ballast for Mombasa Road Project
description: Kenya National Highways Authority (KeNHA) requires supply of approximately 10,000 cubic meters of hard rock aggregates (various grades) and 5,000 cubic meters of railway ballast for the ongoing Mombasa Road dualling project. Delivery location: Athi River quarry staging area. Bidders must supply their own transport. Sample testing certificate from KEBS required with bid submission.
